item.title: TRACE Definition & Meaning - Merriam-Webster
item.description: trace, vestige, track mean a perceptible sign made by something that has passed. trace may suggest any line, mark, or discernible effect.

item.title: Trace (linear algebra) - Wikipedia
item.description: The concept of trace of a matrix is generalized to the trace class of compact operators on Hilbert spaces, and the analog of the Frobenius norm is called the Hilbert–Schmidt norm.
